data.name: Create a new video
data.evaluateGuide:
Uploads a video to YouTube using resumable transfer, with metadata and status details. An agent can initiate a new video upload for later processing.
Use for: upload a video, set video metadata, set publication status
Not supported: video editing, channel analytics, comment management

data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a YouTube video resource and uploads video content, with optional stabilization, auto-leveling, and subscriber notification settings. An agent can publish new videos to a channel.
Use for: upload a video, apply stabilization, auto-level media, notify subscribers
Not supported: video editing, analytics retrieval, comment management

data.name: Complete Video Upload
data.description:
Complete Video Upload
Send metadata of the multi-part uploads to complete the upload and begin processing the video.
Optionally include the MD5 hash of the source video file to validate successful upload before processing.
Parameters
| Name | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| request_id | path | Yes | The request ID returned from the video create request |
Response Codes

202 Video upload completed successfully
DEFAULT Error 4xx/5xx

Response fields
Derived from the spec's response schema.
202 Video upload completed successfully (object)
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| message | string | Yes | Confirmation message |
data.evaluateGuide:
Completes a video upload after metadata and media transfer, then begins processing; an optional source hash can validate the upload. An agent finalizes a previously created video upload.
Use for: complete an upload, validate source media, start video processing
Not supported: creating uploads, video editing, playback management

meta.q: Use YouTube Data API OAuth to resumably upload one private MP4, preserve upload session after interruption, and verify video processing status.
